subject: Brightport MAP: security package timeline & next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brightport.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + draft MAP (security milestone & SOC 2 artifacts)

Thanks again for the time today — very helpful call. Summarizing the key points and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestones so we have shared expectations. Please confirm owners and the target dates below.

High-level ask: Brightport's procurement target is end of Q2; you mentioned aiming for a final decision by 2027-06-30. To support that timeline we agreed Redwood would deliver a SOC 2 evidence package and an answered questionnaire within two weeks of receiving your security questionnaire.

Draft MAP (security-focused milestones):
- Milestone A: Share Brightport security questionnaire (you) — due 2027-05-07 — Owner: Brightport (Elena/Priya)
- Milestone B: Redwood returns completed questionnaire (Redwood) — target 2027-05-20 — Owner: Marcus / Priyom
- Milestone C: SOC 2 evidence bundle (logs, configs, vendor attestations) — target 2027-05-27 — Owner: Redwood Security (Priyom)
- Milestone D: Security review call + outstanding ask list — target 2027-05-31 — Owner: Brightport security (Priya)
- Milestone E: Procurement final review / PO issuance — target 2027-06-30 — Owner: Brightport Procurement (Adam)

Dependencies we flagged:
- Brightport to assign a security reviewer and share questionnaire by 2027-05-07
- Redwood to provide a compact evidence index and a SOC 2 summary PDF. Some evidence (audit logs) requires SRE assistance and may be redacted.

Attached: BP_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_DRAFT_v0.1.xlsx (MAP workbook with a milestone tab), and Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (one-page summary of controls + scope).

Next steps / requests:
1) Please confirm the Brightport security contact to receive artifacts (you mentioned Priya Rao).
2) Confirm the procurement target (is 2027-06-30 still accurate?).
3) If approved, can we book the security review call on the week of 2027-05-31? I can send a calendar poll pending your confirmation.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally to make sure evidence is queued.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: BP_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_DRAFT_v0.1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brightport.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@brightport.com>, Adam Chen <adam.chen@brightport.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:21:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP (security milestone & SOC 2 artifacts)

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming: Priya Rao is our security reviewer (cc’d). Procurement target remains 2027-06-30 assuming no major surprises in the security pack.

We will share our standard security questionnaire (NDA’d) by end of day tomorrow 2027-05-07. For clarity, Priya asked: can you provide an itemized evidence index that maps to the questionnaire sections? That will help our team triage.

Also: a few notes from our side
- We may need a technical deep-dive during the security review if the questionnaire flags infra-level questions (SRE + platform architecture).
- Redaction is fine for any customer data in logs; we need attestations on retention windows and where logs are stored.

If Redwood can commit to returning the questionnaire by 2027-05-20 and the evidence bundle by 2027-05-27, that should align to our internal timelines. Please include a point-of-contact on Redwood’s side for any clarifications.

Elena
Elena Martinez
Head of Procurement | Brightport
elena.martinez@brightport.com | +1 (212) 555-0114

[Attachment: Brightport_Security_Questionnaire_vBP_20270507.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Brightport security questionnaire + MAP timelines — need SOC2 artifacts / owners

Forwarding Brightport’s questionnaire (attached). Brightport (Elena / Priya) confirmed the procurement date 2027-06-30 and want our questionnaire answers by 2027-05-20; full evidence bundle by 2027-05-27. Can you confirm internal owners and whether the proposed dates are achievable?

Suggested owners (please update):
- Questionnaire answers (Marcus / Priyom) — draft by 2027-05-18, final 2027-05-20
- Evidence index & bundle (Vanessa) — collate from SRE, CCS, and GRC teams — due 2027-05-27
- Technical deep-dive (if requested) — Engineering SME (TBD) — target week of 2027-05-31

Key evidence items requested / expected (Brightport asks; approximate):
- SOC 2 report (redacted) or SOC 2 summary PDF
- System architecture diagram (hosting, regions, network segmentation)
- Access control list & IAM role descriptions for service accounts
- Retention policy and sample logs (redacted) showing retention windows
- Third-party vendor attestations (KMS provider, monitoring vendor)
- Change management tickets and a sample incident postmortem (redacted)

Vanessa — would you own compiling the index and a short note on redaction approach? Priyom — can you prepare the questionnaire answers and identify any items needing legal redaction? I’ll be the Brightport-facing POC.

Thanks — Marcus

[Forwarded Attachment: Brightport_Security_Questionnaire_vBP_20270507.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Brightport security questionnaire + MAP timelines — need SOC2 artifacts / owners

Thanks for the ping — I’ll take the questionnaire and start drafting answers. Quick read-through + plan below.

Commitments and proposed internal timeline:
- 2027-05-12: Priyom to complete section mapping (which questionnaire sections require evidence vs. narrative)
- 2027-05-18: Draft answers for internal review (Marcus + Vanessa)
- 2027-05-20: Final questionnaire submission to Brightport (via Marcus)
- 2027-05-24: Evidence index (CSV) and SOC 2 summary PDF ready for review
- 2027-05-27: Evidence bundle delivered to Brightport (secure Drive link / signed DPA constraints applied)

Planned evidence list (preliminary):
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (control scope + auditor statement)
- Audit logs export (redacted) — retention sampling for Jan–Apr 2027
- IAM matrix and snapshots of RBAC config (screenshots)
- KMS vendor attestation (KMS_Cert_2026.pdf)
- Incident postmortem (redacted) for incident on 2026-11-12
- Change management: sample RFCs and approvals (redacted)

Notes / dependencies:
- SRE needs to pull log samples (I’ve queued a ticket with ops; ETA 2 business days once approved).
- Legal needs to validate redaction approach for postmortems and log snippets — Vanessa, can you loop in Legal for a quick sign-off?
- We’ll provide a one-page index (SOC2_Evidence_Index.csv) mapping each evidence file to questionnaire item numbers.

I'll upload everything to a restricted Drive folder and share a secure link to Brightport once we have Legal approval on redactions. Also adding HubSpot deal link and will update the deal stage to "Security Review" when questionnaire goes out.

Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
